summary.zh: 大标题每一行从看不见的遮罩下面升上来，带一点点旋转，行间错峰，最后一条细线画出来。进入视口才触发。
summary.en: Each headline line rises out from under an invisible mask with a hint of rotation, staggered, then a hairline draws in. Fires when it enters the viewport.

technique.zh: 每行外层 overflow:hidden，内层 translate3d(0,105%,0) rotate(2.5deg) → none；IntersectionObserver 加 .in；transition-delay 递增。
technique.en: Outer line is overflow:hidden; inner goes translate3d(0,105%,0) rotate(2.5deg) → none. IntersectionObserver adds .in; transition-delay steps per line.

adapt.zh: 每一行用 … 包起来；正式用时删掉 script.js 里那行循环的 setTimeout。
adapt.en: Wrap each line in …; remove the demo loop setTimeout in script.js.
